title: Gosh Valley
description: A half-time dub-tense slow-builder: off-beat sawtooth chord stabs swell out of a cavernous OberheimDMX pulse, climbing through a four-chord minor progression with delay-thrown echoes. The arc rises to a first peak, drops into a hollow sub-and-stab valley, then swells back to a darker, fuller second peak before stripping bare.
